invented.quote: Every day we fill prescriptions for state employees, retirees and their families.
invented.why: The brief refers only to 'state employees' health plan' and 'plan members', and does not state that the plan covers retirees and their families.

invented.quote: Since January, the plan has paid us less than it costs to fill those prescriptions.
invented.why: The brief states only that the plan pays less than cost on average for the 20 most-filled generic drugs, not for all prescriptions filled for plan members (and the user notes state that some pharmacies make up part of the loss on brand-name drugs).

invented.quote: We lose money on each of those prescriptions.
invented.why: The brief states that the $1.80 loss is an average across the 20 generic drugs, not that the pharmacies lose money on every single prescription.

invented.quote: No small business can lose money on a fifth of its work for long.
invented.why: The brief states that plan members make up 22% of total prescriptions and that the pharmacies lose money on the top 20 generic drugs, not that the pharmacies lose money on the entire 22% (a fifth) of their prescriptions.
